title: Blue Wave Adventures TursiOps Dolphin Watch Cruise Murrells Inlet
blurb:
Spot dolphins in their natural habitat aboard the Tursi-Ops, a custom-built vessel designed specifically for dolphin watching. With individual forward facing seats for maximum 40 passengers and 360-degree views, you’ll enjoy an intimate experience on this family-friendly cruise. Knowledgeable guides share insights about local marine life and dolphin behavior, ensuring an engaging outing for all ages. Safety is a priority, with all trips led by USCG licensed Master Captains. Ideal for families or marine wildlife enthusiasts, this cruise promises a memorable adventure on the waters of Murrells Inlet.

- Custom-built Tursi-Ops vessel for optimal dolphin viewing
- Maximum of 40 passengers for a personalized experience
- Guided tours with educational commentary on dolphins
- Family-friendly, suitable for ages 3+ (children under 3 and pregnant women not permitted)
